### 269. BASE ENSEMBLE SIZE x DIVERSITY CURVE FROM STORED OUTPUTS (written 15 Nov 08:29 CET, before any result; research thread; coordinator's probe 3 on the data-scale front)
Mechanism: the shipped base is 4 net families (fb, fbl, fbraw, sinc) x several seeds. If new-people accuracy still rises with the number
of nets, a larger base (cheaper nets, distillation) is a lever; if it is flat, the base is net-saturated and the gap is data. Stored
material: runs/diag/ttt/probs18/ttt18<order>d<draw>_<family>_base-all_loso-s<seed>.npz (proba, index; LOSO over ten people), 4 families x
6 seeds (24 nets) for the within orders present. Form (alone, a reading of the base, not a chain score): per person, mean posterior of a
subset of k nets, balanced accuracy per cell, person-equal mean over ten people and over the available orders; subsets: all
(f families x s seeds) with f in {1,2,3,4}, s in {1,2,3,4,5,6}, 20 random draws per cell of the grid (a fixed rng), curve BA(n_nets)
split into seed-axis (same families) and family-axis (same total n); fit BA = a - b / n^c on n; report the extrapolated BA at n = 48, 96.
Prediction: seed axis 1 -> 6 seeds per family +1.2 (80 % range +0.5 to +2.0), flattening: 4 -> 6 seeds +0.2; family axis worth more
than the seed axis at equal n (fbraw dropped costs < 0.3); the extrapolated gain 24 -> 96 nets <= +0.5. Rule: gain 24 -> 96
extrapolated >= +1.0 with the 6-seed point inside the fit's interval -> a chain check (shufcombo with the 1-seed vs 6-seed base on 4
shuffled orders) and a cheaper-net/distillation pre-registration; < +0.5 -> recorded, base is net-saturated; between -> undecided.
Silent no-op guards: assert every (family, seed, order, draw) file exists and that index arrays agree across nets; assert that a
1-net subset equals that net's own BA from its file.

### 270. DREYER 2023 AS EXTRA MI PEOPLE: WHY IT COLLAPSED, AND A FORM THAT REMOVES THE CAUSE (written 15 Nov 08:30 CET, before any result; research thread, coordinator's request)
Why it collapsed (archive/OPTIMIZATION_R5.md:80-104, 19 Oct; one seed, four members, PROTEUS-only 56.2/53.5/52.6/59.2 -> +Dreyer 44.9/50.6/48.2/52.8): not a bug
or label mapping but a structural confound the note diagnoses. Every Dreyer session is MI only (left/right hand); session alignment recentres
each session on its own mean, so an aligned MI window sits at the identity, where PROTEUS puts the three-class session average. The model
learns "centred = MI". Also 27 of 41 channels (interpolation null space, same note). Since then the corpus entered only as pretraining
for the external teacher (the part of the teacher's +1.4 J that is Dreyer's is unmeasured). The raw files are NOT local (data/dreyer2023/
holds the OSF manifest only; scripts/export_moabb.py skips unreadable Dreyer recordings); the windows export must be found on a cluster
(runs/extharness-style export, `$WORK/ni26/data`) or rebuilt there; no download is started from the Mac.
Form (core level first, CPU, one cluster; both sides on the 27-channel intersect, core1's recipe unchanged, lr10, LOSO over the ten people,
new-people protocol of §263): arms (0) PROTEUS 27-ch only (the reference); (1) + Dreyer, per-session centred, as MI (replicates the
collapse; mechanism check); (2) + Dreyer, per-session centred, then shifted by the PROTEUS MI-class offset: m_MI = mean over the
training people's MI windows of (centred tangent vector) minus nothing, i.e. the average position of the MI class in centred space, added
to every Dreyer window (fit on the training people of the fold only); (3) arm 2 with Dreyer rows at weight w in {0.1, 0.3, 1}
(mixing q: 87 people at q<1). Left/right is mapped to one class (MI); a second form, only if (2) is positive: Dreyer's L/R as an
auxiliary two-class head on the shared trunk of the nets (centring then stays valid, two classes per session).
Prediction: (1) -3 or worse vs (0), people up <= 2/10 (the mechanism); (2) removes at least 60 % of that loss but is not above
(0) at w 1: 0.0 (80 % range -1.5 to +1.0); best w 0.3: +0.3. Rule: (2) >= +1.0 with >= 7/10 people up over (0) -> pre-register the net
form and the chain check; between -0.5 and +1.0 -> undecided, one more form (the auxiliary L/R head, mixing); < -0.5 -> Dreyer closed in
the MI-label form, the L/R auxiliary form left as the one open form. Guards: assert the channel intersect is identical in both corpora,
the offset is fit on the fold's training people only, every arm's cache key carries the arm, 0 Dreyer rows in arm (0).

user's Galvani 2FA copy and is a separate pre-registration once its raw zips are local.

**§290 IMPLEMENTATION NOTE (16 Nov, by date -u+1h, before any §290 result; executor).** Code studies/15nov/s290/ (s290.py core arms, collect.py, submit.sh; ttt290.py + cell.sh/task.sh + submit2.sh part 2). Definitions fixed here: classes 0 MI, 1 SUB, 2 WORD; all LRs are scaler + LR C=10 (lr10, the primary head of s263), person-LOSO over the ten people, features = s263 variant Z (core1: CAR, shrinkage 0.1, log-Euclidean reference k 2, ov17 x [full, 0-2 s, 2-4 s] + slow block; per-session centring is inside Feats). Band sets by geometric centre of the ov17 bands: mu+beta = centres 8-30 Hz (8 bands: 8-12 ... 24-32), theta+alpha = centres 4-13 (5 bands: 3-6 ... 10-14), theta+alpha+gamma = those 5 + centres 30-45 (28-36, 32-40, 36-45). P1 channel regions: S1 sensorimotor = C1-C6, Cz, CP1-CP4, CPz, FC1-FC4, FCz (17); S2 = Fz, F1-F6, AF3, AF4 (frontal), Pz, P1-P6, PO7, PO8 (parietal), FC5, TP7, CP5 (left fronto-temporal) (21); the regional views are built on the channel subset with their own CAR and their own slow block (as variant D). P1a: stage 1 MI vs rest on S1 (mu+beta), stage 2 SUB vs WORD (trained on SUB/WORD rows) on S2 (theta+alpha); posterior = [p, (1-p)q, (1-p)(1-q)]. P1b: stage 1 on all channels (Z columns, same bands, slow block), stage 2 as P1a. P1c: flat core1, asserted equal (1e-9) to the stored s263 Z lr10 of that person in every fold. P2: pairs MI-SUB, MI-WORD, SUB-WORD, each its own LR on that pair's rows, fused by Price pairwise coupling; P2a bands only (MI pairs mu+beta, SUB-WORD theta+alpha+gamma, all three segment types), P2b segments only (all 17 bands; MI pairs early 0-2 s, SUB-WORD late 2-4 s, no full-window blocks), P2c both. P3a: one-vs-rest LR per class, Platt scaling fitted on out-of-fold decision values of leave-three-people-out fits within the nine training people (held-out person in no fit), posteriors renormalised; P3b: geometric mean of P3a and P2c, renormalised. The slow block is in every model. Column counts, bands and channel lists are written into every output json (spec). Part 2: R2 = fbl_coral10_am50 (existing ARM name), R3 = fbw2_dist2 (fb student n_filters_spat 64 = width x2, T 2, weight 0.5; width x1 = fb_dist2 of the s283 grid), R4 = tsm_lr3e4 and tsm_lr3e3 (default 1e-3 is s288 tsm); 3 seeds x 4 cells each, ttt290.py asserts the arm applied after fit.

**Reference validation, not a new scientific MLP screen.** Reproduce the exact §292B window-mean/log-FFT features and246→64 GELU→3 MLP. Input is finite float32(N,41,480), means/FFT computed in double, bands4–8/8–13/13–20/20–30/30–45Hz, power divided by480² and log floor1e−20; features outputfloat32. **Whole alternative models.** Ten all_loso folds×two seeds×four training arms=80 fits. Every fold excludes all recordings of its held person, with60 fixed epochs, batch128, AdamWlr.001/weight_decay.001 and person×class-balanced CE. Three architectures use fold-fit per-channel RMS (floor1e−8), divide without subtracting a mean. All append the41 normalized per-window channel means so covariance demeaning cannot silently discard the slow/mean view. The temporal encoder learns41→16 spatial projections and three depthwise temporal convolutions(kernel15/31/63), pools log mean-square into48 features, appends means(89), then64GELU→3. The connectivity encoder uses five band covariance/correlation views, learns41→8 projections and vectorizes their36 unique entries(180), appends means(221), then64GELU→3. The hybrid concatenates48temporal+180connectivity+41mean features(269) before64GELU→3. Arms are `temporal_ce`, `connectivity_ce`, `hybrid_ce`, `hybrid_consistency`. The fourth keeps the hybrid architecture/initialization/minibatch order and adds0.1× symmetric KL of clean versus per-row/channel lognormal gains exp(N(0,.1²)) on the same fit rows. Augmentation RNG is separate from shuffle RNG; held rows never enter either loss. ### 306. LABEL-BLIND RANK AUDIT AND INFERRED-INTERFACE JOINT EXPERTS (registered 16 Nov 2026 before implementation or scoring)

**Question and boundaries.** The native PROTEUS release records 41 EEG channels from one M1-referenced acquisition setup; Graz and BrainHero are interfaces, not established different electrode montages. Neither is a general closure.

**Audit (descriptive, no command labels).** Per public session and pinned delivery order, compute centered channel covariance from the prefix at n=1,10,40,last in raw and CAR coordinates, plus condition numbers and eigenvalue counts below 1e-3, 1e-4 and 1e-6 of trace/41. Calculate each window covariance once, then accumulate by order. Separately compare equal-count true-interface subsets only as an offline descriptive oracle, never as inference input. Report sampling counts and numerical floor. Prior: CAR has one numerical null; fewer than 25% of sessions have another direction below 1e-4×trace/41. If ≥25%, this specific prior is refuted. No subject's command labels are opened, and no arm is selected from this description.

**Representation.** Reuse the §301 native reconstructed core: CAR, 17 bands × full/two half-window covariances, 328 slow features, 44,239 features, fold-fitted normalization and causal per-session references across eight pinned orders. Nine fit people exclude the held person completely. CAR40 is descriptive only at this stage. A future intrinsic-basis score first requires a 41-D no-op reconstruction preserving original alpha×trace/41 shrinkage and common-mode scalar power for every block; alpha×trace/40 is a distinct ablation. Removing that scalar can discard relative global power and is not an identity transformation.

**Source-only gate.** Extract current-window per-channel CAR log power in fixed bands 4–8, 8–13, 13–20, 20–30, 30–45, 45–58 Hz. Train a source-only scaler and L2 logistic interface gate (C=.1), with person × class × interface balanced source weights. For each of the nine outer-training people, train its gate without that person; fit its calibration only from seven-person out-of-fold gate predictions entirely inside the remaining eight. Fit the deployed gate on all nine and calibrate it on nine-person out-of-fold gate predictions. Thus neither an outer held person nor an inner held person enters its corresponding gate, normalizer or calibration training. Each gate is fixed at inference; current-window EEG is the only gate input. Log fit-person sets and positive representation of both interfaces and all classes; fail on missing strata. True held interface may be used only for separately labelled offline diagnostics and an explicit nondeployable oracle ceiling, never as candidate input.

**Joint predictive head.** Let z be the identical fold-standardized native 44,239-vector, g the cross-fitted source gate or frozen deployed gate probability, and s=2g−1. Jointly fit multinomial logits `(W0+s Wdelta)z+b0+s bdelta` with person × class × interface balanced source weights normalized to sum N. Optimize weighted mean cross entropy plus `(||W0||² + lambda ||Wdelta||²)/(2*C*N)`, C=.3, lambda in {1,10}; biases are unpenalized. Fit the shared and signed deviation jointly, not residuals on in-sample fitted logits. Controls: unweighted original native C=.3 head parity; equally balanced shared head with Wdelta=0; equal gate s=0 and source-prior gate applied to the same joint head. An oracle true-interface gate is diagnostic only, never a package candidate. Require gate variation, active deviations and deterministic evidence that the gate uses no unavailable fields; zero deviation and constant-gate controls must match their exact definitions.

Predict gated minus balanced shared +0.2 points [−1,+1.5]; lambda10 minus lambda1 0 [−.7,+.7]; true-interface oracle +1 [−1,+3]. A crossing-zero interval is undecided; ≤−.5 with interval below zero refutes only this exact expert form. ### 313. FULL-CHANNEL CROSS-SPECTRAL REPRESENTATION ADDED TO THE STRONG CORE (registered 17 Nov 2026 before implementation or accuracy)

The current system already has a seven-band complex analytic-signal covariance tangent member with full/two-half segments; phase-sensitive features are not absent. §25 and §26 tested amplitude-envelope and cross-frequency coupling as extra members, not the present spectral statistic. §293's weaker connectivity whole model projected 41 channels to eight, used five bands and discarded imaginary cross-spectrum. None isolates this full-channel representation in the strong core. Hypothesis: directly normalized lag-sensitive cross-spectral structure, retained alongside the complete strong representation, supplies complementary class information. Imaginary coherency removes some instantaneous mixing contributions only under assumptions; common-average referencing, spatial mixing, finite-bin noise and ocular/muscle artifacts still affect sensor features. Do not interpret an effect as direct neural connectivity. See [Nolte et al. 2004](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15351371/) and [Stam et al. 2007](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6871367/).

For each official 41×480 current-window tensor, apply the existing common-average reference. For the full 480 samples and each separate 240-sample half, subtract each channel's segment mean, apply a Hann taper, and take the real FFT. For bands [1,4), [4,8), [8,13), [13,20), [20,30), [30,45), [45,58) Hz, average complex cross-products over all included frequency bins with common taper-power normalization. Form per-channel log spectral power, and the strict upper triangle of each real or imaginary cross-spectrum divided by the square root of the corresponding diagonal powers, with a fixed 1e−12 positive floor. Keep signed imaginary terms and fixed channel ordering. This yields 861 log-power features and 17,220 pair features per real or imaginary view. Feature extraction is per current window only; no other windows, target labels, interface, subject or timestamp enter. Source-only scaler statistics are fitted separately per fold. Multiple frequency bins are required for every segment/band. This is not Hilbert tangent-space recentering, a causal session statistic, phase slope direction, or a claim of physiological causality.

Use five matched C=.3 unweighted multinomial CE plus weight-only L2 models, each retaining the full 44,239-dimensional §301 strong features: BASE with no added spectral block; POWER with log powers; REAL with powers and real pairs; IMAG with powers and signed imaginary pairs; BOTH with powers plus both pair views. The REAL and IMAG forms have equal dimensionality and share every other processing choice. BOTH has 17,220 more dimensions than either, so its contrast has a capacity/regularization confound. The fixed original strong head and existing complex Hilbert member remain independent controls. Source-only StandardScaler and model are fitted on exactly nine outer-source people, no held-person labels; full-session references are permitted for source rows, whereas held strong features use only the population prior plus delivered current/past windows with a session reset. Fit each deterministic model once per held person, then produce all eight pinned orders and preserve row/permutation/hash provenance. The additional spectral block is static within a window and must yield identical predictions for the same input regardless of ordering or session context. Use the frozen §309 GPU-resident logistic solver only where its exact objective applies; treat the independently fitted BASE as an explicit GPU control, not an assumed copy of the historical CPU head. Any CPU route is separately fixed and recorded, with no automatic fallback.

Evaluate each model as a whole alternative using the unchanged official equal-cell metric and people/order-nested 80% intervals. Also inject its actual posterior difference relative to the original rebuilt strong head in the existing full-current-system core slot, keeping original PC128/shadow/gate/personalisation and six CP bases. This second test is a posterior-only component intervention, not a coordinated feature/stage rewrite. Include exact zero controls for every order, replay OK, pinned stream/row hashes and output provenance; no partial person/order matrices or outer labels during fitting. Before release require real-window source smoke, finite features/probabilities, a known-phase perturbation showing a real signed-imaginary response with unchanged power, zero-lag fixture, no-op/row/order checks, correct CAR and session resets, plus measured resource and time bounds. Mathematical common-phase invariance is checked on the same complex Fourier coefficients; shifting a Hann-windowed raw segment is not assumed invariant. Training, features and all new outputs are Galvani-only within the shared 32-running/272-submitted limits.

Exploratory priors in percentage points: BASE whole new-person balanced accuracy 69.3 [65,73]; IMAG−REAL 0.0 [−1.5,+1.5]; BOTH−REAL +.25 [−.8,+1.4]; BOTH minus unchanged full current chain +.1 [−.7,+.9]. These are not sealed forecasts. Incorrect subject exclusion, inactive view, invalid finite/bin checks, future leakage, inconsistent reference, incomplete matrices, non-exact zero or failed source hashes invalidate a result. ### 314. TIME-LOCAL SPECTRUM AND TEMPORAL-PATTERN WHOLE DECODER (17 Nov, before any §314 accuracy)

**Question.** Test within-window temporal shapes and their time/frequency location, not another 44,239-dimensional tangent/covariance head. Use the official `(41,480)` 120 Hz model-facing window. This fixed-kernel whole decoder is inspired by [ROCKET](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.13051); it is not a ROCKET/MiniRocket reproduction. It shares broad convolution/power ideas with EEGNet, FBCNet, Shallow and the §293 temporal arm. §293 learned 15/31/63-sample kernels but collapsed its temporal branch to 48 global log powers and scored 45.09% whole-decoder official equal-cell; §77's eight-bin broadband view scored 49.4% alone in an older analysis. Neither result tests the fixed time-local waveform representation below. §312's representation-learning/FBCNet work and §313's complex spectral connectivity are separate.

**Arms and feature definitions.** `TF` is the matched supervised baseline: divide each channel by RMS fit on source training windows only, then retain four 1-second channel means (164 features) and 17 overlapping original-core frequency-band log powers per channel and second (2,788 features). The complete baseline has 2,952 features. `TFD` concatenates the same TF features with 6,144 waveform features. For each fixed seed 0/1, select 16 deterministic random bipolar channel pairs without target data; use 12 deterministic asymmetric, zero-mean length-nine kernels at dilations 1,4,16,32. Convolve each normalized, window-demeaned bipolar signal with same padding; in each of four one-second bins retain response maximum and proportion positive. This preserves local transients and order-sensitive filter responses; no EEG encoder, covariance, phase-connectivity map, external pretraining or trainable temporal convolution is used. The 41-channel TF baseline preserves local power and means explicitly. Fixed random features and direct multinomial logistic classifiers make this a whole-decoder comparison; it cannot by itself assert how the representation would integrate as a member.

**Split and training.** Ten held-person folds, two seeds each. In each nine-person source set, hold out one source person selected deterministically by the seed and outer person. Fit RMS, feature standardization and multinomial logistic heads on the other eight, choose C from {.01,.1,1} only by that source person's mean log loss, then refit RMS, scaler and selected-C head on all nine source people. Both arms share the same source split, optimizer, feature rows, seeds and selection rule. The held person's labels are never used for fit, hyperparameter selection, stopping, or pre-score guards. Fixed features never depend on session, previous windows, subject/interface metadata, target labels, or delivery order; predictions are stateless. Emit recording-indexed probabilities and the exact eight pinned shuffled orders, and assert reordered streams equal the same predictions exactly.

**Guards and controls.** Before any accuracy, a synthetic fixed-input test verifies retained means/powers, asymmetric-kernel temporal-order sensitivity after reversing bin positions, deterministic repeated features, nonempty finite feature blocks and zero-change equality of the shared TF prefix in both arms. Real-data no-score pilot checks source-person disjointness, all-class training, source-only RMS/scalers, paired fit rows and active TFD-only features, valid normalized probabilities, deterministic replay and every shuffled order, with no held labels opened for scoring. Freeze source, data, permutation and model hashes. The whole-matrix scorer reuses the official metric and people/order bootstrap; no partial-fold selection. Compare TFD−TF and both to the previously validated 76.22% new-person current-system reference as an external whole-system benchmark, not a matched architecture. Score each arm in full, not as a proxy member; returning-person routing/worker packaging remain unvalidated.

**Predictions and interpretation.** Expected official equal-cell TF 52–70%, TFD 52–72%, TFD−TF +0.5 points [−2,+3] (broad priors, not claimed measurements). People/order interval crossing zero is undecided; a clearly negative paired interval disfavors this fixed random-bank form, not temporal representations generally. Even a positive gain below the full-system benchmark is a representation result, not a demonstrated submission gain. Measure actual CPU extraction, fit, memory, and inference first. Queue a real-data no-score smoke, then all 20 fold/seed fits with at most two concurrent allocations and a complete-matrix scorer. Respect the user-wide 32-running/272-queued reserve; no upload.

### 328. SOURCE-LEARNED SPATIAL MICROSTATE DYNAMICS (17 Nov, before any pilot label score)

**Mechanism/changed assumption.** Whole-window covariances and fixed temporal filters may miss non-Gaussian spatial-state occupancy and ordered dwell/transition patterns within the provided four seconds. Learn sixteen polarity-invariant unit-topography centroids on GFP peaks from P04–P10 only, with equal 2048-peak/person sampling (repeat-free, fail if unavailable), seed328, thirty fixed spherical-kmeans updates. Filter only the current window by fixed FFT support2–30Hz after CAR; this changes model-side representation, never official input. Every sample maps to its maximal absolute centroid correlation. Centroid signs update against assigned sample signs. This is a new small source-learned representation, motivated by Atoms of Thought(arXiv2605.20182,19May2026) and EEG microstate literature; not that paper's six-channel/1000-state sleep-pretrained model or a replication.

**Scope/controls.** Source-only P04–P10 fit; P02/P03 previously exposed development queries; P01 excluded from every fit/calibration/query. Hold validation labels closed until all features and no-score guards complete. No outer or current-chain accuracy. Fixed source-only StandardScaler+LogRegC=.01,max_iter2000,class_weight=balanced,no tuning on query. Six predeclared whole decoders: raw287 mean/sixband-logpower; occupancy16; raw287+occupancy16; raw287+occupancy16+transition256+dwell16; same full form under fixed seed328 within-window token shuffle; same full form from fixed random polarity-invariant sixteen-unit-centroid bank. Raw287 is bit-identical across all three concatenated full forms; no per-window RMS information enters token states, and raw branch explicitly retains amplitude/slow offset. A transition uses neighboring samples only within its window; no transitions across windows. Dwell means duration in samples per observed state, zero if absent. Shuffle preserves occupancy exactly and alters transition/dwell only. Random-bank and learned-bank use identical features, fit labels/head, dimensions and schedule. Existing same-seven-person 40epoch causal raw SessionBN reference from §324 is contextual only; no refit or claim of equivalence. Use existing official protocol.score with interface cells for query reports; token alternatives are stateless and therefore exactly permutation-invariant.

**Predictions/refutation.** Average of two source query people's cellBA: full learned−raw+occupancy +1pp[−4,+6]; learned−samefeature random +1pp[−4,+6]; ordered−shuffled +1pp[−3,+5]; full learned65%[50,75]. These are uncertain hypotheses, not gates. If transitions gain but shuffled gains equally, temporal organization is not established. If random equals learned, a learned spatial prior is not established. Either person's contrary effect or sub-noise differences are undecided, not family closure. A weak whole decoder beating its weaker control is no current-system evidence. No automatic outer expansion.

**No-score feasibility/scope guards.** Validate exact data/source/label-reader hashes; excludedpeople; unit/sign-symmetric centroids; finite features; positive amplitude invariance of tokens and active amplitude raw branch; occupancy/shuffle identity; nonzero transition change; finalsample influence; rowwise prefix/reset/interleaving/order identity; deterministic sourcefit artifact. ### 331. RAW OSCILLATORY SELECTIVE-STATE DECODER WITH STATIC AND LOCAL CONTROLS (17 Nov, before any331data or score)

**Changed assumption and scope.** A whole decoder may need learned, input-dependent dynamics within the actual4-second waveform rather than another head on incumbent covariances or frozen averaged EEG tokens. Independently implement two32-wide residual oscillatory-state blocks at all480samples/120Hz, with source-RMS input scaling, current-window CAR only in the body, fixed9-sample stem, source-standardized identical287mean/log-band-power branch, mean/log-variance pooling and three-class head. State is zero at every window; bidirectional processing uses only the CURRENT complete window, never other delivered windows. This is an original bounded architecture experiment, not Mamba/S5/S7/NeuroMambaNet reproduction or a pretrained model. No external model code/weights are copied. S5(9Aug2022, revised3Mar2023) motivates associative affine scans; S7(4Oct2024) motivates input-dependent stable transitions. The11Nov2026NeuroMambaNet paper concerns different MI-only datasets/22channels and has no usable repository license in the prior audit; do not import it. LuMamba's public repo distinguishes Apache2code and CC-BY-ND4weights; neither weights nor permission to fine-tune them is assumed here. [S5primary](https://arxiv.org/html/2208.04933v3), [S7primary](https://arxiv.org/html/2410.03464v1), [LuMambaprimary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19100).

**Exact mechanism/controls.** Per latent coordinate, transition a_t=exp(−exp(−log_tau+0.5tanh(W_dt z_t))/120)×exp(iω), initialized with τlogspaced.08–2seconds and frequencies2–40Hz, learned frequencies constrained.5–55Hz. Drive has real/imaginary learned projections scaled bysqrt(1−rho²); affine composition (a,b) combines as(a2a1,b2+a2b1), using a direct log-depth Torch scan, not claimed work-efficient optimizedS5/Mamba kernel. Same source labels/loss/initialization/stem/width/pooling/rawbranch/head across L(local, no recurrence), F(static learned timeconstant/frequency, dtinputweight multipliedzero), S(input-selective dt). S/F outputs must match at ZERO-initialized dtweights before training, and activeSdt receives nonzero finite gradients while Fdt has exactlyzero gradient. L intentionally has no recurrent/frequency path and is not a parameter-use equivalent to F/S; report active/total parameter counts. The isolated selectivity contrast is S−F, not S−L. Every original input sample remains available; no downsampling or per-window RMS normalization.

**Source boundary/training.** P04–P10fit ONLY; P02/P03previouslyexposedqueries; P01excluded all rows/statistics/scalers/training. Reuse official tensorSHA2be4187f…1327 and existing selected-label reader, never alter official metric. FitRMS/287momentmean/sd on seven fitpeople only. Seed331, final epoch40, batch32, fixed shuffled minibatches, per-person×classbalanced CE, AdamWlr.001/wd.01, cosine schedule to.01initial rate; same batches/head updates for L/F/S, no query HPO/earlystop. Refit the unchanged source7 fbcnet_raw_sbn/k20/40epoch recipe as a stronger whole reference R on the same CPU route; CPU numerical/RNG differences mean no assumed bitwise parity to earlier A10062.299%. R is a quality instrument, not a matched architecture control. All L/F/S models, source epochloss/classrecalls/gradients/parameter-change records, immutable source/input/row/checkpoint hashes and query probability banks must be complete BEFORE querylabels. **Mechanism/scope.** A coherent whole generative decoder, not a new representation claim or an added incumbent head. **Explicit model.** In source-normalized coordinates fit common diagonal noise shrunk50% toward each of52block median variances plus rank16 source-within-person/class residual covariance. Apply its invertible inverse-square-root transform; allD=44239dimensions remain. LetQ be the orthonormal rank2 span of pooled source class-mean contrasts. Decompose x into a=Q'x and r=x−Qa, retaining all residual coordinates. Fit a_y from pooled class means, per-person centered residual class templates r_gj, and source-person translations b (plus0). A source-global residual template is also a possibleg. Under latent h=(g,π,b),πoneof6permutations, yuniform3: p(x|y,h)=N(a;a_y+Q'b,2I/η) × N_{Qperp}(r;r_g,π(y)+(I−QQ')b,(D−2)I/η). Conditional independence/isotropic noise within whitened views is a modeling assumption, not physiological causality. h has uniform prior; exact sequential Bayes updates logw_h += logsumexp_y(logp(x|y,h))−log3. Predict y by marginalizing the same joint distribution overh; no hard pseudo-label updates. Previous/current delivered windows only; state is one logweight vector reset per session. **§439 Waveform session-memory training under coherent sensor gains, before scoring.** §396 perturbed 12-channel bandpower inputs to a fixed cumulative-mean model. Here learn the waveform encoder, memory writer/reader and head jointly from genuine source EEG. Compute each source session’s per-electrode log RMS, averaging class means equally. Half the training episodes receive a bounded gain pattern (half a sampled pairwise session difference, remove the across-channel mean, clip to log 2). The coherent arm holds the pattern constant through the episode; the independent arm reassigns exactly the same gain patterns across source windows within each block of 12 episodes. Stock §379 provides genuine-only control with identical 360 episodes, initialization, labels and optimizer. Fit memory, static and explicit normalization for both arms on nine source people per fold. Test exclusively unmodified genuine streams on ten held people × eight pinned orders and compare with genuine-only controls, same-weights blank and donor, and frozen full stack. Predict coherent memory − clean +0.7 pp (80% −1.0,+2.4), coherent − independent +0.5 (−0.8,+1.8), coherent memory-minus-blank improvement over genuine-only +0.5 (−1,+2). Directional evidence requires paired lower limits above zero for coherent vs clean and independent; a nonpositive upper bound refutes its contrast. A static gain as large weakens memory attribution. One training seed; same held people examined previously, no release claim. Guard source isolation, matching multiplicities, batch pin, session reset/online parity and original control endpoints. Smoke source before full jobs.
